# Config: WindowSwitcher

> **Reader:** `WindowSwitcherConfig` (`config/WindowSwitcherConfig.qml`)
> **Schema:** `config/json/config.schema.json` → `properties.WindowSwitcher` · category Workspaces · scope personal

Window switcher: Your windows, most recently used first, while the switch windows keys are held (ALT + Tab and ALT + SHIFT + Tab on the Keybinds page). Releasing the modifier focuses the chosen window; Escape keeps the current one.

Each setting: `path` · type = default · enum/range/unit; then title: description; annotations; `read:` the reader member(s) (exact unless marked) and `in:` the files that use them.


### `WindowSwitcher`

- **`WindowSwitcher.scope`** · string = "all" · enum all|monitor|workspace
  - Windows listed
  - read: `WindowSwitcherConfig.scope` · in: `services/compositor/WindowSwitcherManager.qml`
- **`WindowSwitcher.previews`** · boolean = true
  - Window previews: Show each window's live contents; off shows app icons.
  - x-scope="look"
  - read: `WindowSwitcherConfig.previews` · in: `components/surfaces/switcher/SwitcherTile.qml`
- **`WindowSwitcher.tileSize`** · integer = 200 · 64–480 · px
  - Tile size: Width of each window's tile.
  - x-scope="look", x-control="stepper"
  - read: `WindowSwitcherConfig.tileSize` (computed) · in: `components/surfaces/switcher/SwitcherStrip.qml`, `components/surfaces/switcher/SwitcherTile.qml`
- **`WindowSwitcher.showDelay`** · integer = 120 · 0–1000 · ms
  - Show after: How long the keys must be held before the switcher shows. A quicker tap swaps to the last window without showing it.
  - x-control="stepper"
  - read: `WindowSwitcherConfig.showDelay` · in: `services/compositor/WindowSwitcherManager.qml`
